SEARCH
Package neqsim.process.measurementdevice

Interface TransientMeasurementDevice

All Superinterfaces:
MeasurementDeviceInterface, NamedInterface, ProcessElementInterface, Serializable
All Known Implementing Classes:
LevelTransmitter, PressureTransmitter
public interface TransientMeasurementDevice extends MeasurementDeviceInterface
Opt-in sample-and-hold contract for one physical transient measurement scan.

Sampling advances mutable instrument state exactly once for a physical-step identifier. Controllers, measurement history and alarm evaluation can then read the same held value without consuming filter, delay, noise or fault state again. Implementations remain disabled by default so legacy direct-read behaviour is unchanged.

Version:
1.0
Author:
Even Solbraa
